correctness.rationale: For every integer d>=2 and finite t>=0, the support-spread chamber decomposition is exact with density S^(d-2)(2(1+t)-S), which yields volume 2^d(1+dt), conditional quadratic moments and covariance eigenvalues lambda_parallel=(1+2t+dt^2)/3 and lambda_perp=(1+(d+2)t)/(3(1+dt)). Their determinant and volume produce the stated squared-isotropic ratio, whose logarithmic derivative is 2d(d-1)t(t-1)/[(1+dt)(1+(d+2)t)(1+2t+dt^2)]. All denominators are positive, proving a unique global minimum t=1. Independent rational simplicial integrations matched 12 complete covariance tensors and 3 exact symbolic identities; finite verification does not substitute for the all-dimensional proof.

value.rationale: The lead works motivate an explicit infinite family with known volumes but no recorded interior inertia. The exact two-branch covariance classification plus universal a/ell=1/2 optimum solves a natural affine-invariant continuum optimization, not a routine restatement of the known determinant volume. It provides a reusable exact conditional-spread integration for centrally symmetric alcoved zonotopes. It is restricted to equal cants, and no extrapolation to arbitrary convex bodies is made.
